title: Portable Windows Staging Auto Pilot runtime governance

phases.objective: Prove the portable Windows Staging launcher is deterministic, fail-closed on environment identity, isolated from Production, and able to distinguish healthy services from an exact-SHA Staging environment that is release-ready.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Start-Staging-One-Click.cmd on the exact eligible main commit
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The launcher accepts only the exact eligible SHA, prevents overlapping runs, builds immutable image provenance from that SHA, starts internal-only services, evaluates canonical environment/DB/Gateway authorities, records ready/degraded/blocked certification without hiding repairable Staging degradation, and requires an independent exact live Staging certification before governed Production promotion.
steps: Resolve the exact main SHA and read the Staging eligibility Workflow Run for that same SHA.
Converge deployment branch, environment routing, DB write-authority, Gateway policy, Compose, and image-provenance contracts from their existing sources of truth.
Acquire the single-run lock and fail closed if another launcher is active.
Normalize only manifest-protected line endings, reject real working-tree content changes, and verify raw SHA-256 bytes.
Build the Staging image with deterministic branch/commit provenance and the current generated Staging Gateway policy.

Start the internal Docker topology, wait for service health, then read deployment-info, runtime integrity, combined DB readiness, schema readiness, Governance DB readiness, and Gateway health in the same cycle.
Classify exact identity/provenance mismatch as blocked, DB/schema/Gateway readiness gaps as degraded, and only zero-gap evidence as ready.
Keep a discovered local schema bundle dry-run by default; require explicit ApplySchemaBundle before any local Staging schema seed and re-certify after that explicit mutation.
At Production promotion time, certify dev.mad4b.com and activation-dev.mad4b.com against the exact main release-cut SHA through the existing supporting-gate registry.
assertions: A missing, running, failed, or mismatched eligibility Workflow Run never deploys the SHA.
Repository environment authority sources cannot disagree about Staging/Production hosts, branches, DB fallback rules, or Gateway stale-mutation policy.
Concurrent Auto Pilot runs are rejected by the valid Windows Global Mutex contract and no second Compose operation is started.
Line-ending repair cannot hide non-line-ending content changes and manifest hashes remain deterministic.
The Staging image contains deterministic immutable source provenance and the generated Staging Gateway policy used for live comparison.
A runtime branch, commit, or provenance mismatch is blocked even when containers are healthy.
runtime_app/DB authority failure, missing MCP catalog schema readiness, or stale/mismatched Gateway policy cannot produce certification_status=ready.
A degraded local Staging environment remains available for diagnosis while one-shot Auto Deploy cannot report it as certified and watcher mode re-certifies without blind redeploy.
A local schema bundle never mutates Staging merely because it exists; explicit ApplySchemaBundle is required and triggers same-cycle re-certification.
Production promotion dispatches the registered read-only Staging Live Certification gate for the immutable candidate and proves its tree-identical first parent release cut is live-ready.
activation-dev.mad4b.com is fail-closed unless ACTIVATION_STAGING_GATEWAY_ENABLED=true and uses dedicated Staging OpenAPI/OAuth contracts.
Tenant Activation and Admin Activation use separate Staging schema files with one server URI each.
No Production hostname, Hostinger mutation, Cloudflare DNS mutation, migration apply, provider mutation, or Ruleset mutation is authorized by this journey.

phases.objective: Prove live non-production Windows deployment, exact-SHA Staging certification, and Cloudflare Tunnel reachability after the local Docker image and credentials are available.
blockers: Live Windows Docker Desktop and dedicated Staging Tunnel credentials are external to repository CI.
The live certification gate intentionally remains red/degraded until the Staging DB identities, required schema state, and Gateway attestation are repaired for the exact main SHA.

phases.objective: Prove recovery from Docker Desktop restart, port-proxy failure, interrupted Compose startup, repeated Auto Pilot invocation, and degraded-to-ready re-certification without blind redeploy or database loss.
Validate the exact dev.mad4b.com, mcp_dev.mad4b.com, and activation-dev.mad4b.com non-production canary against one exact main SHA.
blockers: A live dedicated Cloudflare Tunnel token and operator-approved Staging runtime are required.

phases.objective: Keep Production outside the Portable Staging deployment contract while requiring live Staging certification as a read-only prerequisite for the separate governed Production promotion path.
blockers: This feature explicitly forbids Production deployment and Hostinger mutation; Production remains a separate governed promotion authority.
